img_style: Korean ink-and-wash illustration (damchae): fine, confident sumi ink linework with soft transparent watercolor washes, visible hanji mulberry-paper texture across the whole image, gentle color bleeding at the edges, generous empty paper space. Warm cream and muted gold palette with the pink and magenta of the hanbok as the only strong colors. Modern, elegant, refined — a contemporary wedding hall, not an old-fashioned folk painting. Single full-bleed illustration, no borders, no seal stamps, no calligraphy. Vertical 9:16; keep the upper 30% calm and airy for captions. Not photorealistic, not 3D, not anime.
banned: Exactly one person in the frame, seen only from behind — her face is never visible, no profile, no mirror reflection. No text, letters, logos or signs anywhere. No kimono, no obi, no Chinese hanfu, no western church altar, no gold-foil patterns all over the hanbok. No rings, no nail art.
